notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Bug fixes - thank you for the incredible support
notes.notes:
We fixed couple issues with the ending checks, now your previous choices should impact the ending result more consistently!
Also should fix the few achievements that weren't triggering, we will keep a close eye on these and see if any more problems remain.

Don't forget to leave a review & join our discord to chat with us about the game!
